title: Project Connect: Austin's Transit Tech Future
summary:
*   City leaders will attend an important work session on Capital Metro's "Project Connect."
*   The meeting focuses on exploring future public transit options and emerging transportation technologies for Austin.
*   This session is primarily informational, designed for discussion, and no official decisions or actions will be taken.
